slots.hero_headline: Operational AI systems without building an internal team

slots.services_title: Practical AI systems for mid-sized companies
slots.services_subtitle: Start with an audit, hand us the build, or keep us on to run it.
slots.service1_body: For operations leaders whose teams lose hours to manual handoffs. We build and integrate the automation across your systems, then train your team to run it.

slots.cta_headline: Ready to take the manual drag out of operations?
slots.cta_body: Book a scoping call. We’ll look at where AI can remove the most manual work across your teams and outline a clear first step.
